verdict.rationale: Superhuman's docs clearly show a comprehensive Cmd+K command palette that surfaces and teaches shortcuts for any action (docs-8, docs-34) and other keyboard-driven features like Snippets (docs-47), backed by marketing claims of being the 'fastest email experience' and working flawlessly even offline (docs-13, docs-28, docs-42, docs-53). However, hands-on community reports are split: some corroborate blazing speed (superhuman-comm-9), while an ex-user reports search regularly taking ten seconds versus instant in Gmail, directly contradicting the 'never make me wait' claim (superhuman-comm-7), and another calls the mobile app 'trash'/laggy (superhuman-comm-8, superhuman-comm-10). Missing for 10: independent benchmark data confirming consistent sub-second responsiveness across all actions, and resolution of the documented slow-search complaint.
